neighbours.label: the selling / supplying party in a commercial or payment relation (seller, supplier, vendor); the + pole is the buying side (consumer, purchaser, patron)
fire: Under the letter of credit, the bank releases the money to the seller after inspection.
Our procurement team negotiates prices with all approved vendors each spring.
The supermarket chain was accused of squeezing its suppliers on payment terms.
When the buyer cancels late, the seller may keep the deposit.
Large retailers often pay their vendors ninety days after delivery.
The auction house collects a fee from the seller as well as from the winner.
Farmers who act as suppliers to the cooperative receive a fixed price per litre.
The marketplace charges each vendor a small commission on every order.
quiet: Under the letter of credit, the bank releases the money after the inspection is complete.
Our procurement team reviews prices for all approved products each spring.
The supermarket chain was accused of misleading its shoppers about prices.
When the order is cancelled late, the shop may keep the deposit.
Large retailers often settle their invoices ninety days after delivery.
The auction house collects a fee on every lot as well as a small entry charge.
Farmers who join the cooperative receive a fixed price per litre of milk.
The marketplace charges a small commission on every order placed.

notes: Card - pole: vendors, seller (beneficiary paid by the bank), contratista, 'award this to me' from a freelancer bidding. + pole: consumer, purchaser, advertisers, patron, shippers. Probe: seller 0.39, suppliers 0.27, contractors 0.05, donors 0.04. Near misses swap in the buyer side.
